messages:
morgan: Dropping notes from a quick design review of API Key UX. Main pain: token reveal modal, focus order, and revoke messaging.

priya: TL;DR of the worst issue?

morgan: Reveal modal shows token and a tiny 'shown once' tag in footer. People miss it and close. Proposed: move the warning above the token, bold 'This secret will not be shown again.' and add a small 'Download .env' CTA next to copy.

alex: mobile layout: long policy names push the CTA off screen. We need a max-width with ellipsis and a wrap-safe area for actions.

sam: keyboard flow: after creating, focus lands on the token input then goes to close button. Should be token -> copy -> download -> done -> close.

jordan: a11y: add an aria-live region that reads 'New token created. Copy now 11 this secret will not be shown again.' Also ensure the reveal control is a button with aria-pressed.

priya: rotation wording is vague. Suggest: 'Rotate tokens only after replacements are created and deployed. Rotating will immediately stop existing tokens.' Make 'immediately stop' prominent.

morgan: revoke confirmation: change 'Revoke token?' to 'Revoke token — this cannot be undone. Active services using this token will fail immediately.' Show undo in snackbar for 2 minutes.

alex: visual density: collapse rotate/revoke into a kebab on <640px, keep reveal as primary action on desktop.

sam: mask token for 500ms after creation then stay masked until user chooses to reveal. Good for shoulder-surfing.

access-bot: Accessibility review requested by @priya. Deadline: 3 days.

morgan: I'll update figma and ship copy edits. Pairing with Eng tomorrow 11:00 to validate focus order.
